title: check_service_status result
description: The status of one provider as its Statuspage v2 summary reported it at observed_at. A value the page leaves out is null.

indicator.description: status.indicator as the page gives it, for example none, minor, major, critical or maintenance.

description.description: status.description as the page gives it.

updated_at.description: page.updated_at as the page gives it.

non_operational_components.description: Every component, including component groups, whose status is not operational, in page order.

open_incidents.description: Incidents in the summary whose status is not resolved or postmortem, in page order.

source.description: The https address the tool read.

status.description: For example degraded_performance, partial_outage, major_outage or under_maintenance.
For example investigating, identified or monitoring.

impact.description: For example none, minor, major or critical.
